final_answer:
Microsoft’s gross margin improved from fiscal year 2023 to fiscal year 2024.

From the FY2024 10-K data:  
- FY2024 revenue: $245,122M; cost of revenue: $74,114M [DOC: msft_margin.txt]  
- FY2023 revenue: $211,915M; cost of revenue: $65,863M [DOC: msft_margin.txt]

These are directly comparable consolidated GAAP figures for the years ended June 30, 2023 and 2024; no change in fiscal year is indicated in this excerpt.

Calculated gross margin percentages:  
- FY2023 gross margin = (211,915 – 65,863) / 211,915 ≈ 68.9% [DOC: msft_margin.txt]  
- FY2024 gross margin = (245,122 – 74,114) / 245,122 ≈ 69.8% [DOC: msft_margin.txt]  

Change in gross margin:  
- 69.8% – 68.9% ≈ +0.8 percentage points.

ANSWER: Improved by approximately 0.8 percentage points.
